```sh
kafka cluster raft-voter remove
```

Remove a voter from the KRaft metadata quorum

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Removes the explicitly named voter; confirmation controls do not establish quorum safety.

## Before you run

Changes the voting quorum and can compromise availability if the remaining voters cannot form a majority. Verify quorum health and a recovery plan before confirmation.

## Flags

| Flag                            | Description                                       |
| ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`            | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092  |
| `--voter-id <number>`           | the voter’s node id                               |
| `--voter-directory-id <string>` | the voter’s directory id, as a uuid               |
| `--cluster-id <string>`         | expected cluster id, if any                       |
| `--yes`                         | confirm the removal without an interactive prompt |

## Examples

```sh
kafka cluster raft-voter remove --voter-id 4 --voter-directory-id 3c48b... --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "voterId": 2,
  "ok": true
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
